avis.titre: It's the product not dead skin
avis.texte: I know youve all seen the ads. As soon as you put it on your skin and move your hand, the product is rolling up like dried glue. What else would it be good for if its nor actually a peel?
Dont give into the hype like i did, a complete waste of money.
I have seen good reviews witch encourage me to buy this product for my underarms. Unfortunately it did not work for at all. There was no change
I used this product for the first time and then showered immediately after and my skin feels noticeably smoother.
My scars look lighter with the first use. I can't wait to see the results as I continue to use it.

I bought this for my mom after I saw an ad on tiktok of someone using this on their feet. I'm surprised at how good this actually is. It removed SO MUCH built up crusty skin from her feet it was wild. I used this on my heels too and it works just as well as one of those foot cheese graters. I would actually say this is far better because it left our feet so smooth without having to use any lotion afterwards.

I've seen a significant improvement in my skin since using this product. My discoloration and hyperpigmentation have noticeably faded, and my overall skin texture looks much smoother and healthier. I just finished my first bottle and will definitely be repurchasing!

ive only used once on my legs and armpits but wow. there is an immediate difference in how soft my skin feels. the product is thick and easily spreadable and immediately brought up tons of dead skin. i cant wait to keep using this!

I have hyperpigmentation on my underarms and this product has gradually faded the dark marks away. I use it only twice a week due to sensitivity. This made my underarms brighter over the past six week. Definitely recommended!
